verdict.rationale: The evidence pack quotes README-level material from a public GitHub repository, Proa-Labs/proa, covering the core crate, the template macro, and the framework-core adapter, and cites a public benchmarks repo. Together with `proa ui add`, which vendors component source into your own project to edit, this shows the source is readable. No license is named anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for the repo, confirmation that the full framework source rather than just README content is public, independent corroboration.
